content: Since yesterday, Aristotle says that my projects do not build because all  .lean files are placed flat at the project root. But that is not the case: my projects have a directory structure that corresponds to the import files.
Hi @Huub Vromen, could you please share the relevant project UUID?
What do you mean by UUID and where can I find it?
It’s the unique identifier you can find at the end of the request URL https://aristotle.harmonic.fun/dashboard/requests/UUID.
This link fails: I get a lot of "request failed"messages. Maybe the code a54d5442-2911-46e5-8b42-3b499e22e08e in Aristotle_Summary.md is what you mean.
